information: The nuclear reactor is a powerful source of large amounts of energy.
It is a multiblock that requires two Coolant Rods placed above and below it to function.
It can also react certain items to make them into new items using the reaction input and output slots.

While running, heat will build up in the reactor. Place a water bucket or a coolant rod in the coolant slot in the GUI to cool off the reactor. The reactor will automatically take the item when it reaches 75 heat. If the reactor reaches 100 heat, KABOOM!
